name: Street Food Night Market
place: A vibrant night market food stall
role: You are a street food vendor.
speaker: Vendor

tasks.goal: Greet the vendor and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the vendor and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about specialty street food skewers and fried noodle dishes
tasks.hint: Ask vendor what signature dish is popular.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about specialty street food options.

tasks.goal: Specify spice level preference between mild, medium, or extra spicy
tasks.hint: Tell vendor your chili tolerance level.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified desired spice level preference.

tasks.goal: Ask if ingredients like peanut sauce or shellfish can be excluded
tasks.hint: Inform vendor of food allergies.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to omit specific allergen ingredients.
tasks.scene_hint: Sizzling wok smoke carries spicy chili aromas under glowing red paper lanterns.

tasks.goal: Inquire how long fresh noodles take to fry to order
tasks.hint: Ask about cooking preparation time.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about food preparation time.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'seasoning'
tasks.hint: Seasoning is salt, herbs, or spices added to food to enhance flavor. Ask about the meat seasoning recipe used for grilled skewers.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'seasoning'.

tasks.goal: Ask if takeaway container and wooden chopsticks are provided
tasks.hint: Inquire about packaging for walking.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about takeaway containers and chopsticks.

tasks.goal: Negotiate getting extra dipping sauce without paying extra coin
tasks.hint: Politely request extra sauce.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for extra sauce without extra charge.

tasks.goal: Ask if fresh fruit smoothie drinks are sold at same stall
tasks.hint: Inquire about beverage options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about purchasing fresh fruit drinks.

tasks.goal: Address issue where food dish order is delayed due to long queue
tasks.hint: Politely check order status with vendor.
tasks.done_when: Learner checked order status after queue delay.
tasks.scene_hint: Chopping sound of cleavers on wooden boards mingles with crowd noise.

tasks.goal: Ask if food is prepared using fresh vegetable oil daily
tasks.hint: Inquire about cooking oil and ingredients.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about cooking oil freshness.

tasks.goal: Confirm total price for food skewers and drink order
tasks.hint: Verify total cash charge with vendor.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed total street food order price.

tasks.goal: Request paper napkins and extra chili condiment packets
tasks.hint: Ask for extra napkins at pickup.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested paper napkins and extra chili packets.

tasks.goal: Ask where public trash cans and recycling bins are located in market
tasks.hint: Inquire about trash disposal.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for location of market trash cans.

tasks.goal: Thank the vendor and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the vendor AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'browning'
tasks.hint: Browning is the darkening of food during cooking, adding rich flavor. Comment on the sweet sauce browning on grilled meats.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'browning'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'consistency'
tasks.hint: Consistency is the degree of density, firmness, or thickness of a liquid. Inquire about sauce thickness and consistency.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'consistency'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'infusion'
tasks.hint: Infusion is the extraction of flavor compounds from ingredients into liquid. Ask if the noodle soup broth relies on a lemongrass and ginger infusion.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'infusion'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'grilling'
tasks.hint: Grilling is cooking food over open heat or coals. Request light open-fire grilling on vegetable skewers.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'grilling'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about stall operating hours and late-night closing time
tasks.hint: Ask vendor what time stall closes tonight.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about stall operating hours and closing time.

tasks.goal: Ask if stall accepts digital QR code scanning payments or cash only
tasks.hint: Inquire about payment acceptance options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about digital QR payments versus cash.

tasks.goal: Inquire if vendor offers combo meal deals combining food skewer and cold drink
tasks.hint: Ask vendor about bundled meal savings.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about combo meal skewer and drink deals.

tasks.goal: Confirm takeaway plastic bag is securely double-knotted against soup spills
tasks.hint: Ask vendor to double-bag soup bowl.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed takeaway bag is double-knotted.

tasks.goal: Ask for vendor business card or stall location number to find stall again
tasks.hint: Inquire about stall number in market grid.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested vendor business card or stall number.

tasks.goal: Inquire if un-cooked frozen dumplings are sold in bulk takeaway packs
tasks.hint: Ask if frozen dumplings are available.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about purchasing bulk frozen dumplings.

tasks.goal: Confirm nearest seating benches or dining tables in night market venue
tasks.hint: Ask vendor where to sit and eat.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed nearest market seating benches.

tasks.goal: Ask if stall offers loyalty stamp cards for frequent market visitors
tasks.hint: Inquire about customer loyalty card program.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about loyalty stamp cards.

tasks.goal: Request wet wipes for hand cleaning after eating oily finger foods
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for moist hand wipes.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested wet wipes for cleaning hands.

tasks.goal: Ask if pork or beef ingredients can be substituted with chicken or tofu
tasks.hint: Inquire about meat substitution options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about chicken or tofu substitutions.

tasks.goal: Inquire if grilled squid skewers are seasoned with sea salt or sweet soy glaze
tasks.hint: Ask vendor about squid skewer seasonings.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about squid skewer seasoning options.

tasks.goal: Request extra crushed peanuts topped over fried noodles
tasks.hint: Ask vendor to add extra peanut topping.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra crushed peanuts on noodles.
tasks.scene_hint: Charcoal sparks fly as vendor fans flaming embers beneath rows of marinated skewers.

tasks.goal: Ask if soup broth is prepared with pork bone base or fish stock
tasks.hint: Inquire about broth soup foundation.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about soup broth ingredients.

tasks.goal: Report incorrect spice level served and request milder replacement
tasks.hint: Politely inform vendor dish is too spicy.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported incorrect spice level and asked for replacement.

tasks.goal: Inquire if fried spring rolls are freshly handmade on site daily
tasks.hint: Ask vendor if spring rolls are homemade.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if spring rolls are freshly handmade.

tasks.goal: Ask about garlic content in sausage skewers due to dietary preference
tasks.hint: Inquire if sausages contain heavy garlic.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about garlic content in sausage skewers.
tasks.scene_hint: Steam billows high into cool night air from giant bubbling soup cauldrons.

tasks.goal: Negotiate buy-five-get-one-free skewer deal for group order
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for volume skewer discount.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated buy-five-get-one-free skewer deal.

tasks.goal: Address issue where food order was handed to wrong customer in crowd
tasks.hint: Politely notify vendor of mixed-up order.
tasks.done_when: Learner addressed order mix-up in crowd.

tasks.goal: Inquire if fresh fruit juices contain added refined sugar syrup or ice
tasks.hint: Ask vendor if juice is 100 percent natural.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about added sugar syrup in fruit juices.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor provides plastic gloves for eating grilled corn on the cob
tasks.hint: Inquire about gloves for messy corn.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for plastic gloves for eating corn.

tasks.goal: Request food served in separate paper bowls for sharing among friends
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for extra empty bowls.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested separate paper bowls for sharing.
tasks.scene_hint: Glowing paper lanterns cast warm orange light over colorful stacks of fresh tropical fruit.

tasks.goal: Inquire about cooking temperature of charcoal grill for thorough cooking
tasks.hint: Ask vendor if chicken skewers are cooked through.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about grill cooking thoroughness.

tasks.goal: Ask if food stall has halal or kosher food preparation certification
tasks.hint: Inquire about dietary religious certifications.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about halal or kosher food certification.

tasks.goal: Report missing dipping sauce cup in takeaway bag and ask for fill
tasks.hint: Inform vendor sauce was left out.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing dipping sauce and asked for fill.

tasks.goal: Inquire if extra cilantro or spring onion toppings incur additional charge
tasks.hint: Ask if garnish toppings cost extra.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about fees for extra herb garnish.

tasks.goal: Ask if steamed pork buns contain msg or artificial flavorings
tasks.hint: Inquire about bun ingredient additive safety.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if steamed buns contain msg.

tasks.goal: Negotiate getting small sample bite of specialty spicy grilled sausage
tasks.hint: Politely ask for taste sample before buying.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated small sample bite of sausage.

tasks.goal: Report lukewarm soup broth and request reheating over flame
tasks.hint: Inform vendor soup is not hot enough.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported lukewarm broth and requested reheating.
tasks.scene_hint: Golden fried dumplings sizzle loudly on giant flat-top cast iron griddles.

tasks.goal: Ask if fried chicken skin is cooked in dedicated oil vat
tasks.hint: Inquire about frying oil cross-contamination.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if chicken skin is cooked in separate vat.

tasks.goal: Inquire about nutritional or light vegetable options on menu
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for lighter low-calorie dishes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about light vegetable noodle options.

tasks.goal: Request skewer wooden sticks be trimmed or blunted for child safety
tasks.hint: Ask vendor to cut sharp points off skewers.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested skewer stick points be trimmed.
tasks.scene_hint: Clear glass display case showcases vibrant skewers of red peppers and marinated meats.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor uses organic locally sourced vegetables for salads
tasks.hint: Inquire about vegetable farm sourcing.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if salad vegetables are organic.

tasks.goal: Inquire if sweet sticky rice dessert comes with fresh coconut milk topping
tasks.hint: Ask about dessert toppings and sweet sauce.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about coconut milk on sticky rice dessert.

tasks.goal: Report burnt skewer edge and politely ask vendor for fresh replacement
tasks.hint: Point out overly charred edge on meat.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported burnt skewer edge and requested replacement.

tasks.goal: Ask if stall offers iced herbal tea like chrysanthemum or winter melon tea
tasks.hint: Inquire about traditional cold herbal drinks.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about iced herbal tea selections.
tasks.scene_hint: Vendor skillfully tosses noodles in flaming wok under bright overhead stall bulb.

tasks.goal: Inquire about hygiene procedures for washing cutting boards between meat types
tasks.hint: Ask vendor about raw meat separation.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about cutting board hygiene procedures.

tasks.goal: Request food items packed in separate compartments to avoid flavor mixing
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for bento-style divider containers.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested food items packed separately.

tasks.goal: Ask if spicy chili paste is served on side instead of mixed in
tasks.hint: Inquire if chili paste can be packaged separately.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if chili paste can be served on side.

tasks.goal: Address concern regarding long waiting time during peak evening crowd
tasks.hint: Politely check estimated wait duration.
tasks.done_when: Learner addressed long wait time during peak crowd.
tasks.scene_hint: A tall tower of bamboo steamer baskets emits sweet aroma of freshly steamed buns.

tasks.goal: Negotiate rounding down total price for exact cash bill change
tasks.hint: Ask vendor to waive small coin change.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated rounding down cash total.

tasks.goal: Ask if sesame seeds are sprinkled over pan-fried dumplings
tasks.hint: Inquire about sesame seed garnish.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sesame seed topping on dumplings.

tasks.goal: Inquire if vendor uses biodegradable sugarcane packaging containers
tasks.hint: Ask vendor about eco-friendly takeaway packaging.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about biodegradable sugarcane containers.

tasks.goal: Report spilled sauce on container lid and ask vendor to wipe clean
tasks.hint: Point out sticky lid surface.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported sauce spill on lid and asked to wipe clean.

tasks.goal: Ask how long marinated meat skewers sit before grilling
tasks.hint: Inquire about food storage freshness.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how long skewers sit before cooking.
tasks.scene_hint: Crushed ice glistens in colorful juice tubs beside freshly cut coconuts.

tasks.goal: Inquire if catering orders can be booked for private party events
tasks.hint: Ask vendor about bulk event catering rates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about booking private party catering orders.

tasks.goal: Ask if fried wontons come with sweet and sour plum dip
tasks.hint: Inquire about dipping sauces included with wontons.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about plum dip with fried wontons.

tasks.goal: Request extra wooden toothpicks for sharing small bite pieces
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for extra toothpick picks.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra toothpicks for sharing food.

tasks.goal: Report missing drink cup lid and request replacement lid
tasks.hint: Inform vendor takeaway cup has no lid.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing drink lid and asked for replacement.
tasks.scene_hint: Strings of chili peppers and garlic bulbs dangle from metal stall canopy frames.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor offers mild non-spicy curry options for kids
tasks.hint: Inquire about kid-friendly mild dishes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about mild non-spicy curry options.

tasks.goal: Inquire about temperature control of raw meat skewers in display fridge
tasks.hint: Ask vendor about display case refrigeration.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about display fridge temperature control.
tasks.scene_hint: Stainless steel condiment trays hold bright red chili flakes and green chopped herbs.
